title: The coast,and a York treat.
summary: The lighthouse gives the day its setting. The funny details make it ours.
search: The journalYork, MaineFamily field noteYork, Maine · a family moment with a lobster-shaped sweet.York & the Nubble · Family field noteThe coast,and a York treat.The lighthouse gives the day its setting. The funny details make it ours.Come alongAn afternoonwithout much plot.York made it into our camera roll through a view, some sea air and a lobster-shaped sweet. The Nubble can be the destination without becoming a list of things to finish.Looking for practical details? From our family notebook · York, MaineThe view arrives first.York is very good at reminding us that an outing does not need a narrative arc. Sometimes the entire story is: we drove to the coast, we saw the ocean, somebody got an absurd Maine-shaped sweet, we looked at a lighthouse, and everyone went home with salt in their hair and the agreeable tiredness that comes from having actually been somewhere.The Nubble works especially well because so much of the pleasure arrives immediately. You do not have to hike for an hour before you earn the view. There it is: rock, water, white lighthouse, red roof, gulls doing what gulls do, and the ocean making everything else seem temporarily less important.
